groupRequest.label: What type of group request is this?*
groupRequest.name: groupRequest

options.label: Add a member to an existing group
Remove a member from an existing group
Request access to an existing group

memeberNote.value: In this section, you can add or remove members of your group. Note: Only the owner or a delegate of the group can perform this action. If you are not the owner or a delegate, do not proceed.

groupName.label: Enter a group name (max 14 characters). You may use letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
groupName.name: groupName
groupName.help: Enter a group name (max 14 characters). You may use letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)

groupAdd.label: Provide the NetIDs of members to add to the group, one per line
groupAdd.name: groupAdd
groupAdd.help: Provide the NetIDs of members to add to the group, one per line

groupRemove.label: Provide the NetIDs of members to remove from the group, one per line
groupRemove.name: groupRemove
groupRemove.help: Provide the NetIDs of members to remove from the group, one per line

justification.label: Briefly explain why this membership change is needed
justification.name: comments
justification.help: Describe why the listed members need to be added to or removed from this group.

newGHroupNote.value: In this section, you can provide all the information needed to create a group. The group name cannot contain spaces or special characters other than underscores (_) and hyphens (-). We recommend choosing a descriptive group name.

groupName.label: Provide a group name (no special characters aside from _ and -)
groupName.name: groupName
groupName.help: Provide a group name (no special characters aside from _ and -)

groupMembers.label: Provide the NetIDs of members to add to the group, one per line
groupMembers.name: groupMembers
groupMembers.help: Provide the NetIDs of members to add to the group, one per line

justification.label: What will this group and shared directory be used for?
justification.name: comments
justification.help: Briefly describe the work that requires this group and shared directory.

newGHroupNote.value: In this section, you can request access to a group. This is typically used to gain access to restricted software or a specific group directory. HPRC staff will evaluate the request and, if needed, contact the group owner. Please make sure you have a legitimate reason for requesting access.

groupName.label: Provide the group name you want to access
groupName.name: groupName
groupName.help: Provide the group name you want to access

justification.label: Explain why you are requesting access to this group (e.g., project storage, shared software, collaboration, etc.)
justification.name: comments
justification.help: Explain the purpose of this group request, what the group will be used for, and why you should have access.
